name: spawned-runner for out-of-repo imports under coverage
description: Bun coverage instruments any in-process dynamic import, even a copied module tree under /tmp — importing an install's SDK in-process dragged the All-files coverage row to 61% and tripped check:coverage. Load such trees in a spawned runner process (same isolation as CLI spawns) and pipe the JSON result back.

name: Seed separate history databases for CLI and SDK fleet baseline parity
description: A fleet run with history writes its current report. Give CLI and SDK independent databases seeded with the same baseline so the second surface cannot compare against the first surface current run and silently lose an added hotspot.

name: bounded-duplication-oracle
description: Duplication migration oracle rejects oversized exhaustive inputs and never treats exhausted legacy results as truth; freeze corpus hashes and numerical limits before candidate work.
